_readme: Edit this file to change hours, prices, or contact details. No code needed. Save, commit, push — the site rebuilds automatically. Prices are strings so you can include the euro sign exactly as you want it displayed.

business.name: Café Velo
business.descriptor: A cycling-themed cafe on the Carrigaline main road — sun-warmed courtyard tables, green shopfront, long hours either side of the weekend.

hours.note: No booking system — walk in, or ring ahead if you're bringing a crowd.

differentiators.title: Velo, as in bicycle
differentiators.body: Named for the bike, not the beans. Cycling prints on the wall, a wheel on the sign — the kind of cafe you'd find two villages over in the Vaucluse, dropped onto the Carrigaline main road.

differentiators.title: Open when a cafe usually isn't
differentiators.body: Most places on this road pull the shutters at 3. We're still pouring at half nine on a Friday, and both weekend mornings run the full day — 8:30am to 7pm, no early close.

differentiators.title: Green door, olive trees, no chain in sight
differentiators.body: Navy fascia, sage-green pillars, two olive trees either side of the door. It reads more Aix-en-Provence diner than high-street coffee chain, because that's exactly what we built it to be.

menu.note: The board changes with what's fresh out of the oven — this is the short list. Full allergen menu and daily specials are on the counter.

categories.name: Breakfast
categories.eyebrow: All day, every day we're open
categories.blurb: Eggs any way you like them, on sourdough, with roast potato on the side if you ask nicely.

items.desc: Egg of your choice, 2 oak-smoked rashers, 2 Jack McCarthy sausages, black pudding, white pudding, hash brown, beans, roast tomato & toast.

items.name: Velo Chorizo Hash

items.desc: Bagel or sourdough with smoked Atlantic salmon, topped with homemade hollandaise.

items.name: Eggs Benedict

items.name: Smashed Avocado

items.name: Full Vege Breakfast

items.name: Pulled Pork Breakfast Bagel

items.name: Porridge

categories.name: Coffee & Juice

items.name: Flat White
